<title level="1" right="Class Feature 1">[Peerless Inventor](/Classes.aspx?ID=19)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 15

**Class** Inventor
</column>

---

You are constantly inventing, and your skill at crafting is unimpeachable. You gain the [Inventor](/Feats.aspx?ID=798) skill feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites.
name: Peerless Inventor
